notFound.title: Chart not found
notFound.description: This chart does not exist on this device: it may have been deleted.

loadError.title: Could not calculate the chart
loadError.description: The birth data did not produce a valid chart. Check the date, time and place.

toast.exportError: The image could not be created.
toast.primaryError: The choice could not be saved.

hero.hint: Tap a gate, channel or center to read what it means.

accuracy.title: Time reliability
accuracy.approximateNote: The time is approximate: below you can see what would change by moving it half an hour either way.
accuracy.unknownNote: Without a time the chart is calculated at 12:00: below you can see what may change over the whole day.

timeWarning.nonexistentLocalTime: This local time does not exist (daylight saving jump): it was moved forward.
timeWarning.ambiguousLocalTime: This local time is ambiguous (clocks going back): the first occurrence was used.
timeWarning.timeUnknown: Birth time unknown: the chart is calculated at 12:00 local time.
timeWarning.timeApproximate: Approximate birth time: the result may change slightly.
timeWarning.historicalTimezone: Date before 1970: historical time zone data is less reliable.

sensitivity.error: The analysis could not be completed.
sensitivity.stableBody: Within ±{{range}} type, authority, profile, cross and channels stay the same: a small inaccuracy does not change the summary.
sensitivity.unstableBody: If the real time differs from the one entered, these elements could be different. Check the time on an official document.
sensitivity.quiet_one: Another {{count}} line shift does not change the summary.
sensitivity.quiet_other: Another {{count}} line shifts do not change the summary.

activations.intro: Design on the left (red), Personality on the right. Tap a cell for details.
activations.caption: The 13 activations: Design and Personality

hint.defined: Connected to a channel: steady, consistent energy.
hint.undefined: Has active gates but no complete channel: sensitive to the environment.
hint.open: No active gates: absorbs and amplifies what is around.

channels.definedIntro: Two connected gates form a channel: a stable quality of the chart.
channels.none: No defined channels: every active gate is hanging.
channels.hangingIntro: Active gates whose channel is incomplete: their energy lights up when you meet someone with the complementary gate.

variables.notationHelp: P = Personality (Motivation, Perspective), D = Design (Determination, Environment). L = left arrow, R = right arrow.
variables.caveat: Variables need a very precise birth time and are an advanced layer: read them as prompts for observation, not verdicts.

cross.note: The cross is made of the Sun and Earth gates, at birth (Personality) and at the Design moment.

print.title: Print
print.hint: The sheet is A4 and prints with the light theme colors. In the print dialog choose "Save as PDF" to get a file.
print.footer: Calculated on your device with Swiss Ephemeris: your birth data never leaves the device.
